negative_controls.name: transpose_omitted_bb84
negative_controls.note: UNDETECTABLE on W1: BB84 states are real, so rho^T = rho and G is unchanged. Run on a complex ensemble.

negative_controls.mechanism: value deviation from MVW Sec. 3.3 six-state value 2/3
negative_controls.name: transpose_omitted_six_state
negative_controls.note: Detected: omitting the transpose models a phase-conjugating cloner on a complex ensemble.

negative_controls.name: subsystem_order_mvw_YZX_fed_as_XYZ_n1
negative_controls.note: UNDETECTABLE at n=1: for BB84, G_1 is invariant under permuting its three tensor factors.

negative_controls.name: subsystem_order_missing_W_pi_n2
negative_controls.note: Detected: Q (x) Q without the W_pi permutation of MVW Sec. 3.4 mislabels input/output registers.

negative_controls.name: bit_order_swap_verifier_n2
negative_controls.note: SDP value is invariant (the optimal attacker absorbs the SWAP); the bug is flagged because an honest note is accepted with probability 0.375 < 1.

negative_controls.mechanism: value deviation + game guard (W2, not W1)
negative_controls.name: threshold_per_note_n2_t1
negative_controls.note: Two independent per-note threshold checks (>=1 of 2 positions): value 1 (split attack). The W1 theorem does not apply.

negative_controls.mechanism: value deviation; cross-check equals MVW eq. (4) = 15/16
negative_controls.name: threshold_mvw_R_n2_t1
negative_controls.note: MVW Sec. 3.5 success event is '>= t positions where BOTH copies pass', a different event from two independent per-note thresholds.

negative_controls.name: secret_basis_given_to_attacker
negative_controls.note: Attacker given the secret basis clones perfectly (value 1). Violates the W1 trust model.
